s: Din hammoshit keli mereshut lirshut ubo g' seipim: haya omed birshut hayyachid, vehotzi yado melea perot lirshut harabbim betok asara (o apillu lekarmelit) — asur lehachazirah apillu derek mala measara ad lemotzae shabbat, sheqqenasuhu chakamim lihyot yado teluya kak ad lemotzae shabbat al sheabar al dibrehem veasa aqira mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheasa ken bemezid, abal beshogeg lo qenasuhu chakamim, umuttar lehachazirah leotah chatzer shehu omed bah. Abal asur lehoshitah lechatzer acheret, apillu shettehen shello, sheen tzarik erub, vaapillu hu beinyan sheen bo mishshum moshit mereshut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid derek reshut harabbim, kegon shechatzerot ellu hen zo keneged zo verochab reshut harabbim mapsiq benehen, o apillu hen bidyuta achat ella sheen orek reshut harabbim mapsiq benehen kelal, shershut harabbim mehalleket lipnehen velo benehen, vehammoshit mereshut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid eno chayyab ella keshershut harabbim baemtza, kemo shehaya bammishkan — ap al pi ken aseru chakamim kan, kede shello titqayyem machashabto shennitkavven lepannot happerot mechatzer zo, sheim nattir lo lehoshitan lechatzer acheret, hare nitqayyema machashabto, veyesh ligzor shemma paam acheret yashliken lirshut harabbim. Abal keshemmachazirah leotah chatzer, kevan shello nitqayyema machashabto — en ligzor kelum bezeh:
Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehotziah lirshut harabbim, abal im hotziah lekarmelit — muttar lehoshitah apillu lechatzer acheret, shebbekarmelit lo gazeru gezera zo, mishshum shehi gezera ligzera:
